text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Curfews are so annoying. Especially
before a
race, when I should be
speaking more with you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I may not live in the dorms, but everyone has to be out of the academy when they close the gates...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. You can just come over to
my
place. No curfews there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! I'm already excited for the
discussions
we'll have—and for the races
that await us!
